interactions.mechanism: A geopolitical flare-up ON TOP of rising oil is a supply-shock accelerant — the risk premium compounds the price move → inflation + CAD stress beyond either alone.
High oil into an already-hot CPI compounds the inflation signal → RBI stays tighter for longer → rate-sensitives hit harder.
Rising oil AND a strong dollar compound the import-bill + outflow hit — a weaker rupee imports inflation while foreign capital leaves; jointly more bearish than either alone.
Rising US yields with a strengthening dollar is the classic FII-outflow accelerant for EM equity — the combined pull exceeds the sum of parts.
